title: Author Ravi Hanj arrested as Karnataka cracks down on book that ‘distorts’ Basavanna’s teachings

ai.summary: Karnataka's Congress government arrested Kannada author Ravi Hanj for allegedly distorting Basavanna's teachings in his book 'Basava Mantapa', which sparked protests and accusations of disrespecting the 12th-century reformer.

facts.claim: Karnataka's Congress government arrested Kannada author Ravi Hanj
facts.quote: On Saturday, Hanj was detained at Kochi International Airport while trying to leave the country.

facts.claim: allegedly distorting Basavanna's teachings in his book 'Basava Mantapa'
facts.quote: These are some of the statements and writings in Chicago-based Ravi Hanj’s 600-page book, Basava Mantapa, that have sparked intense uproar in various quarters, drawing scrutiny and criticism for allegedly distorting the reformer’s works and teachings.

facts.claim: sparked protests and accusations of disrespecting the 12th-century reformer
facts.quote: The government will not remain silent if the honour of our Basavanna is violated. However, it is condemnable that an author named Ravi Hanj has written a controversial book titled ‘Basava Mantapa’ and has insulted Basavanna in a very derogatory manner.
